description: List and search official Netherlands air quality measuring stations (RIVM Luchtmeetnet). Filter by place or station name (Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Utrecht, Den Haag...), or pass latitude/longitude to get the nearest stations with distance. Returns station number (e.g. "NL49012"), location, and coordinates — the station number feeds luchtmeetnet_measurements and luchtmeetnet_air_quality_index. Example: luchtmeetnet_stations({ search: "Amsterdam" })

latitude.description: Latitude — together with longitude, returns stations sorted by distance (nearest first)

longitude.description: Longitude — together with latitude, returns stations sorted by distance (nearest first)

search.description: Text filter on station location, e.g. "Amsterdam", "Rotterdam", "Utrecht", "Van Diemenstraat"

name: luchtmeetnet_stations
title: Luchtmeetnet Stations
